size.$description: Size of a line icon: 17.5 px at a 13 px root.

size-small.$description: A small icon: the action row to the right of a message plate (13.5 px).

slot.$description: Width of the chat emoji slot in the list: not narrower than the glyph. The Apple Color Emoji glyph at font-size = icon.size is wider than 1em (about 1.2 em, 21 px at a 13 px root), and in a slot one em wide it stuck out to the right and ate the gap to the title (22 px).

line-height.$description: Emoji line-height multiplier in the slot: 1, so the box equals the font size and does not add the ascent and descent of body line spacing (it put the glyph below the center).

shift.$description: Optical vertical correction for the emoji in a chat row: the system emoji font has its own ascent and descent, and a glyph at the geometric center of the row sits below the text center; the correction raises it (-1 px). Chosen from a screenshot of the real window (WKWebView).

row.$description: Size of a chat emoji in a sidebar row: 16.25 px (D2; it was `in-tile` before the emoji lost its tile). The Apple Color Emoji glyph is about 1.2 times wider than the em, so it takes about 19.5 px in the 22.75 px slot (layout.tile.size) and leaves a small margin.

stroke.$description: Icon line thickness in viewBox units (24): thinner than the standard 2, 'airier' next to small text.

size-nav.$description: Icon of the lower sidebar items ('Trash', the profile menu items): 15.6 px (D2). Sits in a slot of size layout.tile.size, in the same column as the chat tiles.
